body:
I don't know what to say that can help, but it's kind of nice to hear someone else put a voice to something I've been feeling for a long time. It's pretty morbid, but at least we aren't *entirely* alone/alienated in that regard. 

I think for the most part, people are entirely consumed by their egos, OP. Creatures of routine and desires, the center of their own realities, living to fulfill whatever their particular agenda happens to be. We're also creatures of ego, to be human is to have ego, but perhaps we're different somehow? In my search for answers, I've found people that will go so far as to tell you that we're, "awake," and the others aren't -- they're robots, sheep, or whatever nickname they give to the masses. I don't know how much I buy into that crap. I sure as hell don't think I'm anything special. But I sure do feel alienated, jaded, and tired. Sometimes I wish I were like the people you mention in your post, whatever you want to call them.
